Hearthloom reads what you've played so your music and podcasts become a taste signal in your knowledge graph.
Hearthloom reads your calendar so events, attendees, and places become part of your knowledge graph.
Hearthloom uses the camera to scan receipts, cards, and documents. Only the recognized text is sent to your node — never the images.
Hearthloom uses your contacts so the people in your knowledge graph resolve to the right person.
Hearthloom uses Face ID to unlock your device token and to authorize unlocking your private vault.
Hearthloom records when a Focus (Work, Sleep, …) is on so it becomes part of your knowledge graph. Only the Focus name and times are sent to your node.
Hearthloom sends your health samples to your own Hearthloom node so your daily summaries live in your knowledge graph.
Hearthloom does not write to Apple Health.
Hearthloom connects to your self-hosted node on your local network.
Hearthloom records your arrivals and departures in the background so your place graph stays complete even when the app is closed. Only coordinates and times are sent to your node.
Hearthloom records the places you spend time so they become part of your personal place graph. Only coordinates and times are sent to your node.
Hearthloom reads your motion activity to record how you move through the day (walking, running, driving).
Hearthloom reads where your photos were taken to add those places to your map. Only location, time, and filename are sent to your node — never the photos.
Hearthloom reads your reminders so they become tasks in your knowledge graph.
